metadata.purpose: M34 phase-guided AVX2 radix-five pass for repeated N=240 inner transforms
metadata.workload: bench-native-sht; established 34-cell C2C and real matrix; seven warmed samples; one transform thread
metadata.timing: six alternating process pairs; CPU 30 affinity; identical commands and workload
metadata.cargo_profile: optimized bench profile; portable x86_64 target; runtime AVX2
metadata.dispatch: reuses the existing low-ido radix-four dispatch pointer; no added planner field and no change to common avx2_pass; radix five is selected only for f64, N=240, (l1,ido)=(48,1)
metadata.candidate1_and_candidate2: Field-based and common-pass dispatch variants were rejected after unrelated C2C/R2C regressions; their raw samples remain in parent and candidate2 directories.
